title: wave start: no way to skip the spec check the owner declined

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Observed 2026-11-11 (slicer wave): the owner chose no spec check at Setup (the relay contract makes it optional), but `ork wave start` started a spec-check step (claude sonnet) on its own; `ork --help` lists no flag to turn it off for one wave (only `ork projects set --spec-check-rows`, which picks rows). Wanted: a per-start flag such as --spec-check off.
